text:
olivia: opened a compact PR adding a tiny console quick card with a cost+latency example and two micro-snippets (JS + Go). keeps the card to ~6 lines and includes a short troubleshooting note about metric aliases. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1402 :sparkles:

sam: nice. can you include a one-line example showing tracekey prefix grouping? teams always ask how to roll up cost by feature.

olivia: done  added a 1-liner for prefix grouping and used `tracekey` (SDKs normalize it). also added a TTL note (short TTL -> more misses -> higher token spend).

priya: two small asks: 1) link by dashboard ID (names drift) e.g. https://console.redwood.ai/dashboards/DB-415-cost-latency 2) include a migration triage line: "If charts show zeros, verify alias mapping: runtime metric -> console metric (e.g., kv_cache_hits -> kv_cache_hit_total)."

olivia: switched to dashboard ID and added the migration triage line. kept snippets micro-sized to fit the quick card. pasted below.

olivia: ```js
// JS: attach tracekey and mark cache hits for cost rollup
await client.call({ model: 'gpt-small', input: prompt, metadata: { tracekey: 'team42/promo' } });
// on server hit: metrics.increment('kv_cache_hits')
```

olivia: ```go
// Go: include tracekey and increment a hit metric for cost grouping
resp, _ := client.Generate(ctx, prompt, map[string]string{"tracekey":"org/ctx"})
// on hit: metrics.Inc("kv_cache_hits")
```

sam: nit: our console expects alias `kv_cache_hit_total` in the cost view. maybe explicitly call out the mapping: kv_cache_hits -> kv_cache_hit_total and note that platform will create a redirect.

platform-bot: FYI scheduled alias mapping update in next deploy window (23:00 UTC). a redirect to DB-415 will be created post-deploy.

priya: also add a short sampling blurb: "span sampling < 1.0 will make latency charts sparse; recommended default for staging = 0.1".

olivia: added sampling note, squashed small edits. docs-bot: CI build passed for PR #1402 but external console link flagged by linkcheck plugin (please add allowlist comment).

olivia: action items: 1) platform to push alias redirect 2) sam to confirm runtime emits mapping in staging 3) priya to quick sanity-check wording 4) olivia to request final review after adding allowlist comment. will ping when done. :pray:
